rule: R2 passes when the judged share is no lower than the control share minus quality.jury.maxShareGap (0.2)
note: It passes by the rule: 1 of 15 on the judged pictures against 0 of 10 on the controls, and the judged share is no lower than the control share less 0.2. One juror of five took the build's picture at the fire for (b), a photograph of a made object, 85 sure: the first (a) or (b) a picture of this build has drawn in four rounds. The two controls were not asked again: they are the approved images, unchanged, and their ten votes of round 3 are carried over and marked. All fifteen jurors answered and none was replaced. What the rule does not see: fourteen of fifteen answers call the build's pictures a render, (c) or (d), and every juror of the page at rest chose (d).
